resolved.title: if 条件语句
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Decision Making[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The [b]if[/b] statement is used to execute some code if a condition is true.

[s0l0!-header][b]Syntax:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="cpp" ][b]if [/b](condition) {
   statements
}[/code]
The [b]condition [/b]specifies which expression is to be evaluated. If the condition is true, the statements in the curly brackets are executed. 
[note]If the condition is [b]false[/b], the statements are simply ignored, and the program continues to run after the if statements body.[/note]

resolved.title: 儿童免费入场
resolved.problem_statement_md:
7岁以下的儿童可以免费进入游泳池。
给定的程序输入**年龄**`age`。

完善代码，如果孩子的**年龄**小于7岁，则输出"免费"。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The If statement[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

Admission to the pool is free for children under 7 years of age.
The given program takes [b]age [/b]as an input.

[b]Task
[/b]Complete the code to output "free" if the child's [b]age[/b] is [b]less[/b] than 7.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
6

[b]Sample Output[/b]
free

[note]Don't print anything if the [b]age [/b]is above or equal to 7.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: - 如果**年龄**大于或等于7，就不要打印任何东西。
